title: サイレンススズカ、覚醒②

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Reporter Etsuko Otonashi invites Taiki Shuttle along to watch the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There are two runners to watch out for—the previous Umamusume of the Year, Air Groove, and the current favorite Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, Silence Suzuka reigns victorious with a stunning breakaway, winning over the hearts of even more fans.
